items.title: 99 IPs but a C2 ain’t one: An Active Intrusion Campaign Against Check Point Security Management Servers
items.description: GreyNoise recently discovered an intrusion campaign targeting Check Point Security Management Servers, with confirmed attack activity between October 17th and November 2nd, 2026, impacting at least 22 distinct organizations globally.

items.title: Global Event: Java4Shell (CVE-2026-114938) Live Activity Report
items.description: GreyNoise is monitoring scanning and exploitation attempts against CVE-2026-114938, also known as "Java4Shell," a memory-corruption vulnerability in OpenJDK's Base64 decoder.

items.title: GreyNoise Expands Real-Time Edge Intelligence in Elastic Security
items.description: The integration includes purpose-built Kibana dashboards for edge observability, detection rules that correlate perimeter and network activity with GreyNoise intelligence, and real-time enrichment that adds GreyNoise classifications to the IPs in your Elastic Security events.

items.title: Global Event: N-able N-central Live Activity Report
items.description: GreyNoise is monitoring scanning, exploitation attempts, and successful exploitation of a suite of vulnerabilities being referred to as "Able2Shell" and "4EverAble2Shell." There are numerous vulnerabilities associated with this activity, so GreyNoise is opting to focus on the end-to-end intrusion activity against the product in order to expedite intelligence dissemination.

items.title: GreyNoise AI Cyber Index: Benchmarking AI Models on Defensive Capabilities
items.description: GreyNoise benchmarked 46 AI models on real defensive security tasks including network detections, file detections, and attack forensics. See which models are actually capable of helping defenders.

items.title: Global Event: SSHole (CVE-2026-123158) Live Activity Report
items.description: GreyNoise is monitoring scanning, exploitation attempts, and successful exploitation of CVE-2026-123158, also known as "SSHole," a flaw in OpenSSH on musl-based Linux (such as Alpine) that lets an oversized password authenticate to accounts configured to reject password logins.

items.title: Global Event: PHP2SHELL Live Activity Report
items.description: GreyNoise is monitoring exploitation attempts against PHP vulnerabilities CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619, colloquially known as 'php2shell'.

items.title: skynox7: Proxyjacking Edge Devices Into Residential Proxies
items.description: How a live GreyNoise product demo turned into an incident response. Inside a proxyjacking campaign that hit 143 devices across 34 countries.

items.title: Spike in Attacks Targeting Digital Video Recorders in Ukraine
items.description: For months, GreyNoise recorded almost no Hikvision camera exploit attempts against Ukraine. On Sept 21 activity surged for nine days during Russian strikes, almost all from four IPs, then stopped. We can't say if the two are linked.

items.title: Swarming Against Citrix 0-Day Exploitation
items.description: On 24 September 2026, a malicious cyber actor (MCA) used 149.104.78.141 to attempt zero-day exploitation against a Citrix NetScaler Gateway. At the time, there were no CVE-specific detections for the attack due to it occurring pre-disclosure. However, GreyNoise still detected and labeled the activity as fundamentally malicious within seconds due to behavioral detections.

items.title: Open Season on Kapibala: Attacker Steals Over 18,000 Government Records Through WordPress Exploitation
items.description: GreyNoise has been tracking malicious use of an IP address since early June 2026 due to its frequent use in scans and attacks against a variety of technologies. We detail a few of the more notable intrusions we observed including the theft of more than 18,000 sensitive records from a western government.

items.title: Agents Gone Wild: An AI-Orchestrated Global Campaign Against PaperCut NG/MF
items.description: 11 organizations compromised in 26 seconds. GreyNoise breaks down the AI-enabled campaign against PaperCut that hit 440 instances across 48 countries.

items.title: GreyNoise + CrowdStrike: Real-Time Edge Intelligence in Falcon Next-Gen SIEM and Charlotte Agentic SOAR
items.description: Today we’re announcing an expanded integration between GreyNoise and the CrowdStrike Falcon® platform, with new content for CrowdStrike Falcon® Next-Gen SIEM and CrowdStrike Charlotte Agentic SOAR. The expanded integration includes a purpose-built Falcon Next-Gen SIEM dashboard, correlation rules that detect allowed inbound traffic from malicious infrastructure, and SOAR playbooks that bring GreyNoise threat context into automated response workflows.

items.title: Threat Actors Are Posing as OpenAI, Anthropic and DeepSeek to Target Credentials and Secrets
items.description: GreyNoise is observing automated scanners posing as the web crawlers of OpenAI, Anthropic, DeepSeek, and Fortune 500 companies, using forged user agents while requesting the files where misconfigured web servers frequently leak secrets and credentials.

items.title: A New Way to Navigate GreyNoise
items.description: Today, we’re introducing a redesigned GreyNoise Visualizer that makes it easier to navigate those capabilities and brings related workflows together in one place.

items.title: GreyNoise Welcomes New SVP of Adversary Operations
items.description: Former Google Threat Intelligence leader joins GreyNoise as SVP of Adversary Operations to advance proactive discovery and disruption of cyber threats.

items.title: Introducing Tactics: See What Adversaries Do After They’re Inside
items.description: GreyNoise Tactics gives anyone running a Deception Sensor visibility into what adversaries do after initial compromise, automatically mapping qualifying sessions to the MITRE ATT&CK framework.

items.title: Enhanced Detection Engineering at Scale in the Agentic Era
items.description: Check out GreyNoise's new Head of Adversary Engagement, Mark Mager, on why traditional detection engineering can't keep pace with CVE growth — and the agentic pipeline replacing it.

items.title: Now Available: Intelligence Dashboard in the GreyNoise Platform
items.description: With the new Intelligence Dashboard, pin any combination of CVEs, tags, countries, IPs, and GNQL queries into one persistent, always-current view.

items.title: Now Available: The Threat Brief Library in the GreyNoise Platform
items.description: GreyNoise's Threat Brief Library is now live in the Visualizer — browse, search, filter, and download weekly At The Edge briefs, Executive Situation Reports, and more, all built on primary-source sensor data.
